resources.string: Compatibility: via the local SOCKS5 proxy

Native: tailscaled runs the tunnel itself. MagicDNS, split DNS and exit nodes come straight from the daemon.\n• Turning an exit node on or off, or a change in accepted subnet routes, rebuilds the tunnel in place; only if that fails is the daemon relaunched for a few seconds.\n• MTU 1280. If it misbehaves on this device, switch to hev-socks5-tunnel.

hev-socks5-tunnel, the compatibility engine. Every packet goes through the local SOCKS5 proxy.\n• Use it if the native engine misbehaves on this device.\n• Switching engines relaunches the daemon for a few seconds.
Comma-separated subnets that stay on the real network while an exit node is on — the same list as in VPN mode. Link-local addresses always do.
Another VPN app took the VPN slot. TailSocks runs on as a proxy; reconnect to take the slot back.
